description: Support-ticket triage: same three judgments asked in one call per ticket, across all models. Mirrors typesafe.ai's own worked example so Jev is benchmarked on a task it was actually designed for.

is_urgent.instructions: Does this ticket convey urgency (the customer needs action soon, e.g. blocked, losing money, or a live outage)?

tone.instructions: What is the customer's emotional tone in this message?

criteria.calm: Neutral or matter-of-fact, no signs of frustration
criteria.frustrated: Some annoyance or impatience, but not hostile
criteria.angry: Clear anger, hostility, or threats (e.g. to churn, escalate, or complain publicly)

urgency.instructions: How soon does this ticket need a response?
criteria: can_wait: no deadline implied, fine within normal SLA
this_week: some time pressure but not immediate
today: needs a response within hours

tickets.state: Help! My payouts have been failing for 3 days and I'm about to miss payroll. This is a huge problem for my business.
Hi, just wondering if there's a way to export my invoice history as a CSV? No rush, whenever you get a chance.
This is the third time I've had to email about the same billing bug. I'm extremely frustrated and considering canceling my subscription.
Quick question: does your API support pagination on the /transactions endpoint? Docs weren't clear.
URGENT: production is down, customers can't check out, we are losing sales right now. Please call me immediately.
Thanks for the quick fix last time! Small follow up - the dashboard chart still shows the wrong currency symbol for EUR accounts.
I was charged twice this month. Not a huge deal but please refund the duplicate charge when you can.
Absolutely unacceptable. I've been on hold for an hour and no one has responded to my ticket from last week. I want a manager to call me today.
Just curious what your roadmap looks like for multi-currency support. Not urgent, just planning ahead.
